text: Tuesday, after the finding: the cravat recognised, Hunter recovers
why: The catastrophe was Monday night and the body was found the next morning, so it was Tuesday. The maid recognised the cravat and Hunter recovered from his stupor at that point.

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — drug the watchman
why: Hunter is certain the stranger drugged his curried mutton to put the watchman out of action, so this is a possibility the story raises.

text: What was in the stranger's paper? — a drug
why: The stranger wanted the boy to receive the paper, and Hunter was then drugged, so a reader has good reason to think the paper held a drug.
